title: Mexico: national foreign direct investment by financing component
producer: Secretaría de Economía / Registro Nacional de Inversiones Extranjeras (RNIE)
statistical_unit: millions of current USD; notified net FDI flows

conceptual_reference.locators: CNIE 2T2026 report, sections 4.1–4.3, printed pp. 14–15 / PDF pp. 15–16 (universe/categories); section 4.8, printed p.17 / PDF p.18 (revisions)
conceptual_reference.review_scope: Locators retained from the prior source review; not freshly downloaded during this preparation.

extraction_history.preparation: The archived 84-row national extract was hash-checked and split into two files without changing field values. Original workbooks were not downloaded or re-extracted in this preparation.

rights.official_data_license: No XLSX-specific open license was identified in the prior review. No blanket open-data license is asserted.
rights.attribution: Partial numerical extract from Secretaría de Economía/RNIE, 2T2026 edition, recovered 5 November 2026. Analysis, code and figures independently prepared; no official endorsement.

limits: This is a fixed historical edition, not a live data feed or a claim of the latest release.
Annual AC and partial-year OR segments remain separate. No growth rate compares 2026H1 with full-year 2025.
New investments do not equal greenfield projects, announcements or physical investment.
National published totals only; no confidential state-level cells or inferred residual values are included.
Stored decimal lexemes are preserved; exact residuals are reported rather than allocated or explained.
